meta.name: implementing-api-abuse-detection-with-rate-limiting
meta.description: Implement API abuse detection using token bucket, sliding window, and adaptive rate limiting algorithms to prevent DDoS, brute force, and credential stuffing attacks.

copy.tagline: 用速率限制算法检测并阻止API滥用攻击
copy.tagline_en: Detect and block API abuse using rate limiting algorithms
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to protect your API from DDoS, brute force, and credential stuffing attacks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能根据你的需求生成令牌桶、滑动窗口或自适应速率限制算法的Python代码，以及NGINX限流配置，并解释其原理和验证方法。
howto.when: 当你要求实现API速率限制、防止DDoS或暴力破解攻击，或者配置NGINX限流时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个基于Redis的令牌桶速率限制器。
配置NGINX对登录接口（/api/v1/auth/）限流为3请求/秒。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can generate Python code for token bucket, sliding window, or adaptive rate limiting algorithms, as well as NGINX rate limit configurations, explaining their principles and verification methods.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to implement API rate limiting, prevent DDoS or brute force attacks, or configure NGINX rate limiting.

say_en.text: Write a token bucket rate limiter using Redis.
Configure NGINX to rate limit /api/v1/auth/ to 3 requests per second.
